note: Launch caps and session-aware staleness limits for chain 4663, applied by script/SetLaunchCaps.s.sol and checked by script/check-launch-limits.sh. Every amount is in SETTLEMENT TOKEN BASE UNITS (USDG, 6 decimals), not whole tokens: the whole launch treasury is 0.295277 USDG, measured on 2026-10-04, so no cap here can be expressed in whole tokens. Without an audit these caps are the primary loss bound (DEVELOPMENT_PHASES.md Phase 4), and they are sized against the balance that exists rather than a hoped-for one. Raise them in one place, here, once mainnet is stable and the treasury is funded.

caps.note: maxNetOpenInterest x 32 markets x a 50% one-sided move is 128000, which the 150000 pool reserve covers - the arithmetic check-launch-limits.sh runs with MAX_MOVE_BPS=5000. The position cap equals the net open-interest cap so a first trader can open a full position, and the per-market open-interest cap is 4x it so matched two-sided flow has room. The remaining 145277 base units stay in the owner wallet as trading collateral; they are not part of the pool.

session.note: The US equity session, in UTC seconds from midnight: 13:30 to 20:30, Monday to Friday (daysMask bit 0 is Monday). The close is 30 minutes after the 20:00 UTC cash close so that an option expiring at 20:00 can still have its settlement price recorded inside the session. preOpenGrace lets a price stamped up to 90 minutes before the open count as this session's: measured, the first in-session print landed up to 39 minutes after the open, and SPY's last pre-open print an hour before it. THIS WINDOW IS UTC AND US DST MOVES IT: re-run SetLaunchCaps.s.sol on 2026-11-01, when the session becomes 14:30 to 21:30 UTC (openSecond 52200, closeSecond 77400).

staleness.note: 9 hours, the in-session limit for all 32 US equity markets. It is a backstop, not the binding rule: the session floor in PriceValidator is what keeps an earlier session's price out, and inside a 420-minute session a price at the 90-minute pre-open grace reaches 510 minutes of age, so the floor always binds first. The limit cannot be tightened below the session: measured over 180 rounds per feed (up to 102 days, 4 to 74 sessions each), 9 of the 32 feeds printed nothing at all during a whole session, because a Chainlink feed here only moves on a 0.5% deviation or a 24-hour heartbeat. A limit short enough to catch a dead feed mid-session would halt a quiet market instead. Per-market overrides stay available for the crypto and FX markets Phase 11 adds, which have no session and should carry the full 24 hours (86400).
